versions.text: Criterion: Verify that carrier approach and landing are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.6.3 Carrier approach and landing. Standards for UAS shipboard operations are provided by the airworthiness authority. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.
